title: tui: limit:500 in query but server hard-caps at 200
description:
kith-chat/src/message.rs:784 enforces limit.min(200) on Message/query. The TUI sends limit:500 expecting up to 500 messages, but actually receives at most 200. A chat with >200 messages will have silent truncation — the truncation notice (once calculateTotal is fixed) will fire at 200, not 500. The loop 1 limit increase from 50→500 did not achieve its goal.

Fix: either raise the server cap (kith-chat message.rs) to match or document the server cap and set TUI limit to match it. If raising server cap: consider memory budget.
